text_block_list.text: It happened while taking a walk along the seaside...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad we were able to buy
the beach hut's specialty yakisoba bread...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Right? The beach hut owner said it's his masterpiece.
Let's eat it while it's still warm.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
His masterpiece...!
Well then, let's dig――

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Eh? Eek?!

A black kite swooped down and snatched
Nishino Flower's yakisoba bread away!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah-oh,
guess you can't fight nature.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Howe~ver, we've still got an extra life left.
Here you go, Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Eh, u-um...!
Isn't this yours, Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, totally fine.
Today's horoscope said to watch out for pickled ginger anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So it works out pretty nicely
if you eat it instead, Flower~.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Th... Thank you so much...

The next day at the academy, I ran into Nishino Flower,
who seemed to be looking for someone.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um...
To tell the truth, I can't find Sky-san anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to give her right away,
but the only other place I can think of is――

I suggested checking near the forest
where she had been the other day.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
I see...! 
You're right, I haven't checked there yet.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Near the forest... I'm not sure exactly where she'd be,
but I'll go look!
I decided to go search for Seiun Sky together with Nishino Flower.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As far as open spaces go,
this area is the only one left, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ah, Sky-san?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
*mumble*...
Feels like somebody called me... or maybe not...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wait, Flower?
What's up, why're you all out of breath?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
*phew*...
Um, I came to say thank you...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks?
What for?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
You always just brush it off
like it's nothing, Sky-san, but...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Like when you gave me that yakisoba pan at the beach,
or when I dropped something and lost it...

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
And that time there was a house centipede in the flower bed,
you gently let it outside for me, right?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho, did something like that happen?
Ah, youth must be nice with such a sharp memory~

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Um, that's why!
I wanted to make sure to properly thank you today.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Here, a flower crown. I wanted to give it to you
while the blossoms were still fresh and pretty...!
choice_data_list: You worked hard just to give her that flower crown.
A flower crown of gratitude is lovely.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
I ran as fast as I could...!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aw man, is that what it was...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
You were in such a rush, I totally thought
you came to fetch me 'cause my slacking got busted.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh, were you skipping out here?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Whoopsie,
slipped right out, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
G-Geez!
Fufufu, oh Sky-san!

With the flower crown perched on Seiun Sky's head,
she and Nishino Flower walked back to the academy together in harmony.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
...! 
I'm so glad I made it.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Sky-san, once again,
thank you for everything, always!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, you're just imagining things~
Not that it doesn't feel nice to hear, though~?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Even if I am imagining it...
it made me very happy.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Honestly, I really didn't do anything big.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um, Sky-san?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm? Nyaa, never mind.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well, thanks for the flower crown.
Since you're here, why not take it easy and relax for a bit~?

Beneath the sun filtering through the trees,
Seiun Sky and Nishino Flower spent a quiet, gentle moment together.
